measurement_note: Size is n, the number of distinct two-letter words, within the legal maximum of 50. Every forward word appears before the block of reverse partners, keeping matches delayed. The required hash-set pass takes expected O(n), while a correct implementation that compares index pairs completes all tiers but scales as O(n^2).
